RimMandrake.CrackedLands.RM_ClaimCrewPro.label: rival salvage crew
RimMandrake.CrackedLands.RM_ClaimCrewPro.arrivalText: A salvage crew from {0} has walked in to work the flood line. They will dig out what the mud exposed unless you claim it first, but they are not here to fight: they keep a small shop on the claim, selling what they find and buying salvage back. They will be gone in about a day.
RimMandrake.CrackedLands.RM_ClaimCrewPro.collapseText: With relations with {0} gone, their salvage crew no longer respects any claim. They are stripping what is left on the flood line and will run with it.
RimMandrake.CrackedLands.RM_ClaimCrewPro.leaveText: The salvage crew from {0} has packed up and is leaving the flood line.
